## Landed

- `api/src/api/release_serving.py` — `export_catalog_document()`: `/v1/export` prefers the manifest-pinned `releases/<pub>/data/download_listing.json` (the real catalog — absolute mirror URLs, sizes, sha256, licences), falling back to a pre-TX-10b release's pinned `api/export.json` (the `changes_document` idiom). Module docstring names the contract.
- `api/src/api/routes.py` — `/v1/export` wired to the real catalog; three release-namespaced routes: `GET /v1/releases/{pub}/sources` → `r/<pub>/api/sources.json`, `GET /v1/releases/{pub}/sources/{id}` → `r/<pub>/api/sources/{id}.json`, `GET /v1/releases/{pub}/sources/{id}/runs` → `r/<pub>/api/sources/{id}/runs.json` (`sig.source-runs/1`) — the same api-slice twins `/v1/sources` serves, addressed by the pub in the path (citation-grade).
- `tests/api/fixtures/release_registry/` — `releases/<pub-A>/data/download_listing.json` (`sig.download-listing/1`), `r/<pub-A>/api/sources/src_okc/runs.json` (`sig.source-runs/1`), `r/<pub-B>/api/export.json`; both api-slice indexes, both integrity manifests, `catalog.json`, both `catalog_entry.json` and `latest.json` recomputed (digests, artifact counts).
- `tests/api/test_api_release_parity_sources.py` (new, 15 tests) — the parity test: every namespaced answer equals its staged file field by field; the namespaced/unnamespaced agreement; the export catalog preference + fallback + typed absences; a `sig.api-slice/1` index walk asserting every declared doc is served byte-for-byte; the withdrawal barrier.
- `tests/api/test_api_release_parity.py` — the two export assertions re-pinned to the real-catalog contract (fix forward, no loosened check).
